note: Conformance vectors for the search (ADR 0125; ADR 0146 decision 1): the core (src/mobile/core/.../search) answers to them on every app and, through @veyq/core-js/search, on the web (ADR 0155), whose vectors.test.ts runs them over the shipped module beside Memories' search.ts. Each case names the rule it pins (`rule`). Inputs chosen by hand; every `expected` recorded by running the core's functions (SearchVectorsTest with VEYQ_WRITE_VECTORS=1) and read against its rule before commit. Strings are JavaScript's (UTF-16): a fold map's indices count UTF-16 units. `corpus` is the documents a `match` or `matcher` case names as "corpus"; a document with `opensItself` opens itself (a contribution, a person, a settings section). `match` orders with `collator` (the web's Intl.Collator; the core's NameOrder), its names chosen where both agree. `matcher` records fresh scans; a field's matcher must give each step. `facets` reads a Memory's plaintext meta at `now`; `medium` a listed medium's plaintext tier (`meta`, null: did not open) and blob meta, named by `unnamed` without a name. Every capturedAt is 12:00 UTC on a 15th.
